emma p: Quick ask 1: coordinate X + LinkedIn posts this weekend to juice webinar signups. who can take copy + schedule?
diego: I got copy and scheduler. propose primary CTA "Register now" + fallback "Watch on demand".
hannah: timing recs: X Friday 6pm PT (pin), X Sat 11am PT (follow), LI Sat 11:30am PT. also want a reminder Mon morning.
noah: routing check: confirm form uses utm_source=social_weekend, utm_campaign=webinar_apr, and webhook -> /api/leads/webhook. SDR rotation tag = webinar_apr.
emma p: please paste final link with params so I can attach to scheduler.
diego: https://go.redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=social_weekend&utm_campaign=webinar_apr&utm_medium=social&src=threads
hannah: creative: 3 copy variants posted below. choose one and request image sizes.
hannah: ```
A: "Ship reliable inference. Join our engineers Tuesday to see benchmarks & rollout tips. Register: <link> #mlops #inference"
B: "Cut token cost, not quality. We built a serving stack that does both 1. Demo on Tuesday. Save a seat: <link>"
C: "Benchmark highlights: 2.8x cost reduction with caching & batching. See the methods in our webinar. Register: <link>"
```
noah: assets: need 1200x675 for X, 1200x627 for LinkedIn. upload to shared folder and grant marketing.
social-bot: Reminder: schedule window open. use /schedule-marketing with tag #webinar_apr.
emma p: deadline: final copy + images by EOD today. diego will post drafts to channel for quick ack. noah will test webhook with dummy lead 4:30pm PT.
diego: will post drafts in 30.
noah: webhook test passed at 16:34 PT, dummy lead created with tag webinar_apr. all good.
emma p: awesome. last note 1: ensure UTM preserves uid param in scheduler (previous issue). ping if it drops. :rocket:
